assignments.scope: Start from W5 threshold/point26/tf4/global9bc and W8 aggregate/provider frontiers. Follow one previously unresolved direct callee or positive writer behind typed T+68 or first-positive T+F4/Point+26, with source -> transform -> consumer evidence. Do not repeat broad negative scans or rename nearby offsets as the target object. Out-of-range construction 0x4200AC82 is secondary backlog, not presumed required for first slice.
owned_frontiers: Point+26, T+F4 and G425009BC first positive sources
T+68 typed consumer; runtime settings observations, owner+4/B0 provider, enumeration and full target selection
Out-of-range construction 0x4200AC82 and runtime [0x421B8F14] binding, exception unwind/return behavior
acceptance: Fresh source/member hashes, addresses and byte checks for every new claim; explicit conditions and precise remaining frontier.
Implement only evidenced missing behavior, preserving regression APIs, then run focused native, ASan/UBSan and a standalone --handoff byte gate in own BUILD.
Return one committed bounded result with source anchors, tests/exits and preserved failed logs. Coordinator performs integration/full gates/fixed-SHA independent review.
assignments.stop_condition: One coherent new vertical slice (at most two immediately connected helpers), or a precisely evidenced boundary after inspecting the direct source dependencies. No endless search, broad negative scans, fake providers, original DLL execution/loading/emulation, or full GAP closure.
